text:
Use with caution / monitor.

The concurrent use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) such as ibuprofen, which belongs to this class [ibuprofen:clinical_pharmacology:0], and corticosteroids like prednisone increases the risk of gastrointestinal side effects [prednisone:drug_interactions:5]. Patients should use this combination cautiously due to the elevated risk of adverse stomach-related complications [prednisone:drug_interactions:5].
